title: Pentaryn AoE
description: Spell areas everyone can move and delete: each dnd5e template region gets a small owned handle token it is attached to, so dragging the handle moves the area and deleting it deletes the area; the spell card gets a Remove all templates button under Place Template. When a save spell's damage is rolled, the GM's client lists the creatures inside the area, rolls the monsters' saves (GM-only), asks players to roll their own through a request card, and applies full/half/none on a GM-only Apply. Optionally rolls damage straight after an attack hits. A spell's effects go onto the caster automatically when the caster is its only target, and an Effects tray that still has unapplied effects is highlighted. Exposes game.pentaryn.aoe.
